name: inspora
description: Inspora design-inspiration search for the Inspora team: the hosted Inspora MCP (team OAuth sign-in required) plus the inspora-discovery and inspora-design-direction skills.

interface.shortDescription: Find credited design references from the Inspora catalog.
interface.longDescription: Team-only. Searches Inspora's curated websites, designs, logos and icons through the hosted Inspora MCP, and adds the inspora-discovery and inspora-design-direction skills. Each person signs in with an approved Inspora team account.
